title: A Portrait for the Smile
author: J. M. Reyes
blurb: Orsen Vasquez, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
